title: Adaptive PQC Key-Encapsulation for Multipath QUIC Telemetry
venue: SCI 2026 — 8th International Conference on Smart Computing and Informatics
authors: Mayank Rajesh Hete (1st Author) et al.
abstract: Designed a quantum-resistant communication framework using NIST Level-3 PQC primitives (lattice-based KEM) and multipath QUIC transport protocol for mission-critical networks. Published in Springer LNNS conference proceedings.

title: Quantum-Safe Microservices in Financial Infrastructure
abstract: First-author research on quantum-safe microservice architectures for financial infrastructure, addressing post-quantum cryptography migration paths for production BFSI systems.

title: ML Fraud Detection in Financial Systems
abstract: First-author peer-reviewed publication on advanced fraud detection techniques in financial systems using machine learning and anomaly detection patterns.

title: LLM Courtroom Simulation
venue: SCI 2026 — 8th International Conference on Smart Computing and Informatics
authors: Mayank Rajesh Hete (2nd Author) et al.
abstract: Built a multi-agent LLM platform processing unstructured Indian civil law corpora; applied NLP pipelines for role classification, argument extraction, and procedural simulation. Published in Springer LNNS.

title: GANs in Urban Digital Twins
venue: SCI 2026 — 8th International Conference on Smart Computing and Informatics
authors: Mayank Rajesh Hete (3rd Author) et al.
abstract: Conducted a systematic literature review synthesizing 40+ papers across six urban AI domains; proposed a GAN-based simulation architecture for data-constrained developing cities. Published in Springer LNNS.
